name: imagegen-api
description: Generate and edit images through a configured API key with GPT Image 2.6 Flare or Sunburst.

interface.shortDescription: API image generation with GPT Image 2.6
interface.longDescription: Generate, edit, and batch-create images using your own API key. Defaults to GPT Image 2.6 Flare, supports 2.6 Sunburst and explicit 2.5 models, and keeps your configured endpoint.
defaultPrompt: Use Imagegen API to generate an image.
Use Imagegen API with Sunburst to edit an image.
